description: This donut chart visually compares the distribution of deception outcomes across two distinct ambiguity categories, labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner)” in separate legends. The chart is composed of two concentric rings, each divided into three colored segments corresponding to the categories “Deceived” (red), “Partially” (yellow), and “Not Deceived” (green), as defined in their respective legends. The outer ring, representing Ambiguity 1, shows a large red segment labeled 67.6%, a smaller red segment labeled 57.9%, a yellow segment labeled 23.5%, and a green segment labeled 10.5%. The inner ring, representing Ambiguity 2, displays a red segment labeled 8.8%, a yellow segment labeled 23.5%, and a green segment labeled 10.5%. The chart includes percentage labels directly on each segment and a legend for each ring to clarify the color coding, with no segments visually emphasized or exploded. The segments within each ring appear to be arranged in descending order of size based on their labeled percentages.
